attributes.Name: Presidio
attributes.Description: Famous park & recreation area featuring wooded trails, historic sites & Golden Gate Bridge views.

attributes.Name: San Francisco Botanical Garden
attributes.Description: 55 acres of serene gardens showcasing diverse plants from around the world & a magnolia collection.

attributes.Name: Buena Vista Park
attributes.Description: Verdant, 36-acre park featuring trails, live oak groves, San Francisco city vistas & more.

attributes.Name: The Panhandle
attributes.Description: This compact offshoot of Golden Gate Park features sports courts, walking trails & a playground.

attributes.Name: Alamo Square Park
attributes.Description: Green space with a playground, tennis court & views of the city's iconic painted Victorian houses.
